# FadeFlow

> FadeFlow is a company founded in 2023 that builds AI products and custom AI workflow automation to reduce manual work for small and medium businesses (SMEs) in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and India. Its product, FadeLogistics, is web-based workflow and job card software for transport and logistics companies. Its service, AI Workflow Automation, uses Claude AI to automate repetitive tasks such as invoicing, WhatsApp lead qualifying and email filtering without replacing a company's existing systems.

Key facts:
- Name: FadeFlow (website: https://fadeflow.in)
- Founded: 2023
- Markets: United Arab Emirates and India
- Customers: small and medium businesses (SMEs)
- Product: FadeLogistics, from AED 125 per month / AED 1,499 per company per year (app: https://application.fadelogistics.fadeflow.in/)
- Service: AI Workflow Automation (custom quote), built with Claude AI by Anthropic
- Founder: Sayed Adinan
- Contact: sales@fadeflow.in (sales, demos, quotes), tech@fadeflow.in (technical support, privacy), +971 56 581 4649 (phone/WhatsApp)
- Tagline: "Less manual work. More flow."

## Blog

- [How SMEs Can Automate Invoicing with AI (Without New Software)](https://fadeflow.in/blog/ai-invoice-automation-for-smes.html): How UAE and India SMEs can use AI to create invoices from job cards, timesheets and delivery notes, and chase payments, using the tools they already have.
- [WhatsApp Lead Qualification with AI: A Practical Guide for SMEs](https://fadeflow.in/blog/whatsapp-lead-qualification-with-ai.html): Most SME enquiries in the UAE and India arrive on WhatsApp. How AI can reply instantly, qualify leads and pass only serious buyers to your sales team.
- [Logistics Job Cards: Why Excel Breaks and What to Use Instead](https://fadeflow.in/blog/logistics-job-cards-excel-vs-software.html): Running logistics jobs on Excel and WhatsApp works until it doesn't. Where spreadsheets fail, and what a job card system like FadeLogistics changes.
- [9 Repetitive Tasks Every SME Can Automate with AI](https://fadeflow.in/blog/repetitive-tasks-smes-can-automate.html): From invoices and quotations to WhatsApp enquiries and daily reports: nine everyday tasks small and medium businesses in the UAE and India can hand to AI first.
- [AI Automation Without Replacing Your Systems: How It Works](https://fadeflow.in/blog/ai-automation-without-replacing-systems.html): You don't need new software to benefit from AI. How FadeFlow automates work around the email, WhatsApp, spreadsheets and apps your team already uses.

## Free AI resources (time.fade)

- [Free AI resources hub](https://fadeflow.in/resources/): Free, copy-ready AI prompts and guides from @time.fade, FadeFlow's Instagram
- [Roast my profile, then fix it](https://fadeflow.in/resources/profile-roast-prompt.html): Copy a free AI prompt that reviews a screenshot of your LinkedIn or Instagram profile, ranks the top 5 fixes and writes a ready-to-paste bio or headline.
- [Give ChatGPT a task to do later](https://fadeflow.in/resources/chatgpt-scheduled-tasks.html): Give ChatGPT a task to do later. A 5-step guide and copy-ready setup prompt to schedule research, summaries, reminders and checklists in ChatGPT.
- [Make a profile photo with AI](https://fadeflow.in/resources/ai-profile-photo-prompts.html): Make a LinkedIn, Instagram or WhatsApp profile photo with AI. Upload two selfies, pick one of 50 looks and copy a complete ChatGPT prompt.
- [Find the cheapest grocery basket](https://fadeflow.in/resources/grocery-price-checker.html): Compare grocery prices across supermarkets with AI. Copy a prompt that checks current prices and offers, compares full baskets and recommends the cheapest place to shop.
- [4 ChatGPT codes for any book](https://fadeflow.in/resources/chatgpt-book-codes.html): Paste one prompt into ChatGPT, attach a book and type /visualnotes, /mentalmodels, /chaptermap or /themes. Includes 40 book codes for notes, study, quotes and book clubs.
- [time.fade experiments center](https://fadeflow.in/experiments/): Where FadeFlow tests AI on everyday problems in public before turning them into free guides
